compare: bounded causal/predecessor flags where evidence exists
do_not_compare: V1 segment title versus per-event Slice1 title

classification_rules.improvement: only an explicit invariant/fixture oracle proves a V1 defect is absent without losing required obligations
classification_rules.regression: required structural/semantic obligation is lost or richness decreases against an explicit oracle
classification_rules.neutral: creative wording differs while bounded obligations and validity remain
classification_rules.uncomparable: sealed evidence lacks the raw or normalized counterpart

mutation_effect: none; comparison receipts cannot alter V1, shadow artifacts, Draft input, StoryState or Canon
